cim_eredeti: Top Treasury Official Is Too Busy Vibe Coding a Crappy Video Game Clone Instead of Addressing a Historic Hack
szoveg_eredeti:
We’re all guilty of procrastinating. But not all of us are in charge of running the treasury of the wealthiest nation in the world.

 As the Treasury Department scrambled to address a major hack on its internal services, its chief information officer, Sam Corcos, was preoccupied with a little sidequest: vibe coding his own video game, 404 Media reports .

 Corcos, a cofounder of a health tech startup called Levels, was first brought on as a DOGE hire near the start of Trump’s second term and has been spearheading the deployment of AI across the government ever since.

 He apparently loves using AI in his free time, too. On GitHub, Corcos has been using Anthropic’s Claude AI to push regular updates to a project he calls “Legatum,” a clone of the iconic “Civilization” strategy games.

 And we do mean regular. On Tuesday the Treasury Department’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), which handles sensitive information and reports about serious financial crimes, disclosed that it was dealing with a “cybersecurity incident” that led to “unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems.” And in the midst of this — not to mention the flurry of alarming hacks and outages that have beset the tech sector and government agencies over the past few weeks — Corcos was still fiddling with AI to build his game.

 Update logs on GitHub show that during and after the hack, while the agency was still dealing with the fallout, Corcos released balance patches for the game, new theme music for the Aztecs — AI-generated, of course — and overhauled its in-game tooltips system, per 404 .

 He also enthusiastically released a new special unit for Egypt, right at the same time that the Treasury Department warned that FinCEN was taking some of its systems offline “as a proactive measure.”

 As word spread online of Corcos’s extracurricular, or perhaps on the clock, activity, trolls and angry netizens began piling into the GitHub’s project’s discussion board for flagging issues with the game.

 “The Treasury Department is being hacked and you are vibe coding a video game instead,” fumed one issue topic . “Proposed Solution: Delete this repo and fix the security issues at the Treasury Department.”

 Corcos, apparently still having plenty of time on his hands, hasn’t helped his case by individually replying to and hiding the troll’s posts — a task that he’s automated with even more AI.

 “Closing as off-topic,” he responded to the above post this morning. “This tracker is for bugs and ideas about the Legatum game,” he added, with a signature reading “Generated by Claude Code.”

 The jokes continue to write themselves even more readily than his vibe coded video game. His last tweet, 404 spotted, was a defense of DOGE once again demanding federal workers to send in written letters explaining what they do.

 “I believe it is reasonable to ask employees what they are working on,” Corcos wrote .

cim: AI-jal kódolt játékot az amerikai pénzügyminisztérium informatikai vezetője egy kibertámadás alatt
lead: Sam Corcos a Claude segítségével fejlesztette Civilization-klónját, miközben a hatóság érzékeny rendszereit feltörték.
osszefoglalo:
Az amerikai pénzügyminisztérium informatikai igazgatója, Sam Corcos a **Claude használatával fejlesztette saját stratégiai játékát**, miközben az általa felügyelt szervezetnél súlyos kibertámadás történt. A Financial Crimes Enforcement Network érzékeny rendszereit ért illetéktelen hozzáférés alatt a vezető folyamatosan frissítéseket, AI-generált háttérzenét és új egységeket töltött fel a GitHubra.

A fejlesztői platformon megjelent kritikus bejegyzéseket és felháborodott hozzászólásokat a vezető egy automatizált Claude-kóddal törölte vagy rejtette el off-topic indokkal. A felületen a felhasználók élesen bírálták, hogy a hivatal biztonsági problémáinak elhárítása helyett a kódolási hobbijára fordít energiát.

Sam Corcos korábban a Levels startup társalapítója volt, és a DOGE kezdeményezés keretében került a kormányzathoz, ahol a mesterséges intelligencia állami alkalmazását irányítja. Az eset rávilágít az AI-alapú szoftverfejlesztés elterjedésének egy újszerű, munkahelyi fegyelmet érintő mellékhatására.
